registered: 2026-09-26, Kiro, round 3: after the dev selection and the independence audit of the round-3 test renders; before any round-3 test segmentation, localization or scoring

filters.oracle: EVAL-ONLY diagnostic (teacher labels), never a student result

scoring.metrics: vision_loc_cli.py score over exactly the registered test episodes, all at once

groups.door_loaded: door_zone and own-command load state loaded (carrying through door_1)

scoring.recovery: lost (> 0.30 m), recoveries (back below 0.10 m), injections, injections while < 0.10 m
scoring.false_detections: learned column edges outside the teacher-label interval by > 5 px

gate.name: door_1 carrying clearance (unchanged from round 2, prereg.json)
gate.rule: PASS iff, over the pooled test door_loaded frames of the vision filter: lateral p99 <= 0.06 m AND position p90 <= 0.05 m AND yaw p90 <= 3.0 deg, with door_loaded frames (>= 20) in >= 3 test episodes (else INSUFFICIENT_DATA)
gate.not_rederived: the gate is not re-derived in round 3; the round-2 FAIL stands as recorded

report: per filter: door_zone / door_loaded p50 / p90 / p99, lateral p99, yaw p90; all-frame p50 / p90; recovery events; the oracle next to the student (diagnostic); offline replay of teacher-driven renders, not closed loop

secondary.label: EXPLORATORY secondary configuration: scored on the same registered test, reported next to the student, never used for the gate verdict or the student selection
secondary.reason: a3b (slip scales redrawn on load changes + stuck mode 0.01/0.5 per s) gave the best overall dev trade-off (L 5.58 cm, P 6.12 cm, all-frame p90 0.123 m vs 1.512 m, lost 842 vs 5279 frames: the wedged dev s909/s941 recovered), but the registered sequential rule rejected its two components one at a time (interaction). Reported next to the student to show whether the combination generalises; no gate claim.
